title: 关系副词

examples.en: I still remember the day when we first met.
examples.zh: 我还记得我们初次见面的那一天。

examples.en: This is the house where I was born.
examples.zh: 这就是我出生的那座房子。

guess.question: 先行词是表示时间的词时，该用哪个关系词？

options.text: 用关系副词 when（相当于 on / in which）
options.feedback: 对！时间用 when、地点用 where、原因用 why。
不对——从句里不缺主语宾语时要用关系副词，which 是关系代词。
不对——定语从句里没有 what 这个关系词。

rule.rule: 先行词表示时间用 when，地点用 where，原因用 why；关系副词等于“介词 + which”；判断方法：从句成分完整（不缺主语宾语）就用关系副词
rule.formula: ① 时间：the day when… = on which　② 地点：the place where… = in which　③ 原因：the reason why… = for which　④ 判断：从句缺主宾 → 关系代词；不缺 → 关系副词

anchors.en: I'll never forget the day when I joined the club.
anchors.zh: 我永远不会忘记我加入俱乐部的那一天。

anchors.en: This is the school where I studied ten years ago.
anchors.zh: 这就是我十年前读书的学校。

trap.wrong: This is the house which I was born.
trap.right: This is the house where I was born. / in which I was born.
trap.why: born 后面不缺宾语，缺的是地点状语，要用关系副词。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——when 接时间、where 接地点、why 接 reason；从句不缺主宾就用关系副词。

check.stem: I still remember the day ____ we first met.

options.distractor: 从句不缺主宾，要用关系副词

check.explanation: 先行词 the day 表时间 → when。

check.stem: This is the factory ____ my father works.

options.distractor: works 后面不缺宾语，缺地点状语
关系代词不能作地点状语

check.explanation: 先行词表地点，从句缺状语 → where。

options.text: That's the reason why he was late.
That's the reason which he was late.
options.distractor: 从句不缺主宾，要用 why

options.text: That's the reason what he was late.
That's the reason when he was late.

check.explanation: 先行词是 the reason → why。
